messages:
maria: Heads-up — nightly eval flagged regressions in 3 small promptsets for the q4-int4 build of redwood-v2. Kicking off quick triage.

eval-bot: ALERT: nightly/evals failed (suite: small_prompt_bench). failures=3; severity_hint=medium; link=https://ci.redwood/evals/1946123456 :rotating_light:

chris: can you paste which promptsets? easy to eyeball.

maria: failing promptsets = [instruct-summaries, multi-step-reason, fact-check-short]. examples attached in thread. initial manual glance shows shorter outputs and some hallucinations on fact-check-short.

ajay: any platform changes last deploy window? kernel/quant compiler? :eyes:

maria: yes — runtime pushed kernel selector tweak yesterday (optimize for long-seq). might have changed kernel path for short-seq int4. suspecting kernel/codegen mismatch.

sam: I'll run a repro with the nightly artifact. command I'll use: `./eval-local --suite=fact-check-short --model=redwood-v2-q4_int4 --artifact=nightly/1946090000`

lee: if it's kernel selection, rollback candidate = previous selector commit id 5a1f3b. Ajay, do we have a quick canary binary to test?

ajay: yes, canary-ci has a build with revert (id 5a1f3b). I can spin up a job to run the three failing suites on that binary, 2 GPUs, batch=1.

maria: initial severity: P2 (impact: nightly alerts only, started at ~02:10 UTC). owners: @sam repro + @ajay infra test + @maria investigate model/quant config. Notify runtime if canary fails.

chris: tagging product/monitoring? want an ops ticket if it crosses into user-facing.

maria: creating ticket now (ENG-ML-1127). will update with reproducer and diffs.

sam: repro started, uploading first failing sample: "Q: Who founded company X in 2008?" expected: short factual, got: made-up founder + vague timeline. attaching generation output.

ajay: canary run queued (job 1946123570). will post logs/summary here in ~15m.

lee: if canary fixes it, plan = promote revert to next rollout and run regression sweep across nightly. if not, deeper dive into quantization config.

maria: thanks team. next updates: canary result + repro diff. marking this thread as active. :white_check_mark:
